اقتفيتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَفَيْتُنَّ (iqtafaytunna) /iq.ta.faj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اُقْتُفِيتُنَّ (uqtufītunna) /uq.tu.fiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
